BPMN Events

General Concept: BPMN Events represent occurrences that can start, interrupt, or end a process, such as Start Events, Catch Events, Throw Events, and Boundary Events. These elements manage the lifecycle, subscriptions, and variable scoping for events, ensuring they are triggered, handled, and propagated according to BPMN semantics and engine configuration.

  • Catch Events
  • Throw Events

Usage & Options in TaktX:
BPMN Events in TaktX:

  • Support subscriptions for messages, signals, timers, and other triggers.
  • Enable correlation for message events, ensuring correct process continuation.
  • Allow for error handling, escalation, and compensation via boundary and throw events.
  • Provide hooks for monitoring, audit logging, and integration with external systems.
  • Are specialized into catch and throw event types, each with unique options and semantics.
  • Can trigger process start, pause, interruption, or completion based on event type.
